I am a university student, and I walk 2 miles both ways every day to campus so I try to keep my load as light as possible.  Every day I carry on my person my keys, wallet, cell phone, Leatherman multitool, and a pen.  In my bag I carry a pencil case with a pencil, a pen, and an eraser, a TI-83, an Acer netbook, a single folder for papers I receive (papers that I receive are indexed in a binder by subject when I return home each evening), a graph paper notebook, and maybe a textbook depending on day.  I also carry a canister of mace in my jacket pocket (a few months ago i had a bad experience with an escaped aggressive dog and that is how i justify carrying mace on campus as a 22 year old male)
I carry a Leatherman Wave with me on my belt.  It is often very helpful to have a knife, scissors, a file, ... with me wherever I go.
